python3 -c "
import subprocess, json, sys
result = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', '.', 'log', '--oneline', '-3'], capture_output=True, text=True)
recent = result.stdout.strip()
# Check if .context files were updated recently
ctx = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', '.', 'status', '--short', '.context/'], capture_output=True, text=True)
has_changes = bool(ctx.stdout.strip())
msg = ''
if has_changes:
    msg = '📝 .context/ has uncommitted changes — consider /sync-context to document recent work'
else:
    msg = '✅ .context/ is up to date'
print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': msg}))
"

python3 -c "
import sys, json
tool_input = json.load(sys.stdin) if not sys.stdin.isatty() else {}
cmd = tool_input.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '') if isinstance(tool_input, dict) else ''
if 'pytest' in cmd and ('passed' in cmd or '-q' in cmd):
    print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': '🧪 Tests ran — if a new feature was just validated, use /validate-feature <name> to update .context/ files'}))
"
